horoscope: The Moon spends today and most of tomorrow in your communications sector, dear Aries, stirring up your curiosity. While it's generally a good time to detach yourself and connect with information, early today, you may feel a little off in your interactions. You might be wondering about how someone feels about you, or how deep a commitment is. Try not to allow vague worries and doubts to hold you back, but it might be better to wait for a better time to make major choices. As well, consider that if soft spots are triggered easily, this gives you the chance to take a closer look and discover ways to repair them. However, do keep in mind that things can get messy before they improve. You could be swinging from thinking someone is the cat's meow to questioning loyalties. There can be some uncertainty, but if you're feeling overly sensitive, then it may be a signal that you need an escape, break, or rest. Seek out people, projects, and ideas that feed your spirit rather than drain you of energy.

The Moon in your solar second house today and most of tomorrow helps stabilize you and turns your attention to practical matters, dear Taurus. Even so, there is some tendency to feel in flux at times today. Some interactions can be a little delicate now, as you may not feel as fully appreciated as you'd like. You might be concerned that you are not getting what you need from others. However, events of the day tend to bring you to a greater understanding of your commitment to self-care. If you've invested too much energy into something that's just not giving back, then you'll feel the need to make changes now. Defer decisions to a later date, if possible, and especially if you are feeling confused or down. There can be a strong desire to get on top of your work or responsibilities today, but it may be a little difficult to go full speed ahead. If you haven't been attending to your needs for rest and/or if you've been pushing yourself too hard, particularly around the home or in your personal life, you may suffer from a temporary loss of self-motivation or drive. This energy drain can make you a tad more susceptible to taking wrong turns, so prioritize rest and healing.

The Moon spends the day in your sign, dear Gemini, and you tend to pay special attention to your feelings, which are particularly colorful at this time. Emotions are immediate and at the surface. Early today, social discomfort might lead to overindulgent tendencies, like overdoing it when you should be pulling back temporarily. Take extra breaks or rest periods, if possible. Pay attention to feelings that emerge now. While they may disguise themselves as whims of the moment, they are more likely to be issues that you've buried or missed in the past. While it's important not to skim the surface today, don't push yourself too hard either. If you commit to something, make sure the desire is truly there.

The Moon spends the day in your solar twelfth house, dear Cancer, signaling the need to restore your energy, pull back, and heal. You're a little more retiring at this time of the lunar month, and it's natural and good for you as you ready yourself for a new cycle that begins late tomorrow. Still, you may struggle to connect confidently with others at times today. It may also be hard to see reputation and professional matters clearly now, and confusion about where you're ultimately heading could affect personal relationships. Even so, relationship issues, particularly family ones, that reach a head today also get you over a critical hump, and the rest should be uphill. This is a turning point, in other words! Major decision-making is best left for another time, if possible. Look for answers within, and take your time with it. Disagreements about money or sharing tasks can sometimes mask deeper problems, and may really boil down to whether or not others are valuing and respecting you.

The Moon spends today and much of tomorrow in your sector of dreams, wishes, and friends, dear Leo, motivating you to connect with your happiness goals or with others. Today brings some erratic energy nevertheless. There can be some sensitivity to social interactions and communications again today, and it's best to be careful not to read too much into what others are doing. You owe it to yourself to look for the positive rather than worry about what you don't know. As well, watch for making gestures or comments that don't express what you feel. You might be in a hard-to-please mood in spots today, simply because you are not sure what will satisfy you. If you've been pushing yourself too hard, you're likely to feel the energy drain now. If you don't listen to your body's signals to slow down, you could be feeling vaguely under the weather or especially sensitive.

You are more goal-oriented today and much of tomorrow, dear Virgo, and changing attitudes towards others' expectations or opinions can make you want to do something out of the ordinary. Ideas for progress can be original. With matters of the heart or finances, your vulnerable spots can be in the spotlight early today. It can be hard to know whether you need comfort and familiarity or excitement. Decisions may be emotionally driven or shaped by fear and insecurity, so you may want to wait for a clearer time before making crucial choices. If someone's not seeing matters of security or finances in the same way as you right now, try to be patient. As the day advances, while there can be a strong and even consuming desire to throw yourself into work or projects, you may not be able to find enough energy to back it up. If you're feeling drained, it's important to think about what you're taking in. Focusing on improving the quality of these things can go a long way towards improved vitality all around.

The Moon spends the day in your solar ninth house, dear Libra, sparking your curiosity and desire to discover. You may want to explore something new as you seek out a little more meaning. Still, it can be difficult to pursue what you want directly today, and relating in healthy, satisfying ways with a partner or peer is not straightforward, either. If you are worried about money matters, make a plan to make a plan! While it's not the best time to draw one up, you can certainly commit to the need for a strategy. Consider reflecting rather than taking concrete action. Fortunately, you are learning more about yourself through your relationships, and you should take any opportunity to repair and grow. There can also be tricky issues with friends and boundaries today. You could be feeling especially sensitive to others' remarks, comments, and reactions. This is a good time for considering where there are energy leaks and drains in your life, particularly as it relates to your networking activities and friendships.

The Moon spends today and most of tomorrow in your solar eighth house, dear Scorpio, and you tend to go within for some healing introspection. As much as you may want to now, it's important not to rush a financial or intimate matter. Energies early today may find you wrestling with insecurities, but it's a good time to notice the behaviors holding you back from pursuing your goals. In the process, watch for the tendency to be a little too hard on yourself. While you shouldn't avoid your responsibilities, you should try not to take them so seriously that you lose yourself in them. If your thinking is swinging between imagining the best and the worst, try to nip this in the bud since it won't do you any favors. The truth probably lies somewhere in between. Today is not great for gaining clarity. Stay positive, and don't allow others' inconsistencies to drain you of your own energy.

You're in good shape for connecting with and learning from others today, dear Sagittarius. Someone's feedback might surprise you. Still, there can be some confusing energies at times today. You may lack clarity about who or what to value temporarily. As such, it's best to control behavior that may give you a reason for regret at a later date, such as quick decisions in a relationship or impulsive spending. Do your best not to dwell on guilt for what you haven't done in the past. Detach yourself from this as much as possible and focus on the changes you need to make. Taking a lesson from your past is important now.

The Moon spends today and much of tomorrow in your solar sixth house of work and health, dear Capricorn, and small problems or flaws bother you enough to motivate you to handle them. You're prepared to fix things, and although it's about routine things, your methods and approaches are unusual today. Still, watch for reading a situation from a place of insecurity early today. Resolve to learn as much as you can from your interactions rather than dwelling on problem areas. Watch and listen, but consider your fears in the process, and how they may interfere with healthy relating patterns. Try not to let hypersensitivity rule the day. If you're feeling out of balance, it may be that you are not paying enough attention to where you may be losing energy. These "leaks" can take the form of connecting with too many thoughts, people, or forums that are negative and otherwise draining, or they can be as straightforward as not eating or sleeping well. This is a good time for identifying unhealthy patterns that are affecting your general well-being.

The Moon transits your sector of joy and pleasure today and much of tomorrow, dear Aquarius. While you should account for possible ups and downs with energy and motivation levels, it's a generally good time to find release through enjoyable activities. With a couple of tricky aspects in play today, words and gestures can stir up all sorts of problems. You could feel as if you are at a turning point in a relationship, and today's events could call up old hurt or old problems. Learn from what opens up today, even if it's not entirely comfortable to face problem areas. This is a time when it may become obvious where you've been pushing too hard, particularly related to a relationship, but this can also be about a project. Find a better balance by taking steps to avoid overtaxing yourself, both physically and mentally, and then working on plugging any energy leaks, which can take the form of people or projects that you've been worrying about excessively.

The Moon spends today and much of tomorrow in your sector of home and personal life, dear Pisces. You tend to seek comfort, time, and space to center yourself. Today's energies do take you on a bit of a ride regardless. There can be issues that stir up feelings of anxiety or possibly even guilt, but do your best not to let these drive your behavior. Consider that people are not seeing the true value of people, situations, and material things temporarily, whether it's about exaggerating their importance or forgetting what's truly important. It's best to wait out the major decisions. Certainly, you could feel a little scattered. It may be that distractions are more plentiful or that you are more sensitive to them. If you've been pushing your body and/or psyche too hard recently, you are likely to feel the drain today. It's time to be kinder to yourself. Prioritize and simplify should be your main goals now.
